cases.input: Compare the payment behaviour of Delta Logistics and Fortuna Trading.
cases.answer:
## Payment Behaviour Comparison: Delta Logistics vs Fortuna Trading

**Summary:** 3 invoices totalling €36,000 | €24,000 paid (67%) | €12,000 outstanding (33%)

| Invoice | Issued | Due | Amount | Status | Payment Date | Timeliness |

| INV-011 | 2026-08-01 | 2026-08-31 | €12,000 | Unpaid | — | **Overdue by 1 day** |

**Payment Pattern:** Mixed reliability. Paid 2 of 3 invoices (67%), but one was early and one was 2 weeks late. Currently has 1 overdue invoice.

---

### Fortuna Trading SA (Switzerland)
**Summary:** 3 invoices totalling €65,500 | €43,500 paid (67%) | €22,000 outstanding (34%)

| Invoice | Issued | Due | Amount | Status | Payment Date | Timeliness |
|---------|--------|-----|--------|--------|--------------|-----------|
| INV-014 | 2026-02-10 | 2026-03-12 | €25,000 | Paid | 2026-03-10 | **2 days early** |
| INV-015 | 2026-05-10 | 2026-06-09 | €18,500 | Paid | 2026-06-20 | **11 days late** |
| INV-016 | 2026-08-10 | 2026-09-09 | €22,000 | Unpaid | — | **Not yet due** |

**Payment Pattern:** Similar to Delta Logistics—paid 2 of 3 invoices (67%), with one early and one late. However, the outstanding invoice is not yet overdue (due 2026-09-09).

---

### Key Differences

| Metric | Delta Logistics | Fortuna Trading |
|--------|-----------------|-----------------|
| **Payment Rate** | 67% (2/3) | 67% (2/3) |
| **Outstanding Amount** | €12,000 (33%) | €22,000 (34%) |
| **Overdue Status** | ✗ Has 1 overdue invoice | ✓ No overdue invoices |
| **Average Payment Delay** | Mixed (6 days early, 14 days late) | Mixed (2 days early, 11 days late) |
| **Reliability** | **Lower** – inconsistent, currently overdue | **Higher** – more consistent, no overdue items |

**Conclusion:** Both customers have similar payment rates (67%), but **Fortuna Trading is the more reliable payer**. While both show mixed timeliness on paid invoices, Fortuna Trading's outstanding invoice is not yet overdue, whereas Delta Logistics has an invoice that is already 1 day overdue.
